compy.py.summary: Compress Python sources so they fit into an LLM prompt.
details: Strips the comments, the shebang, the docstrings, the annotations and the stdlib imports, renames the local variables to short names, joins the simple statements and writes the compacted sources to ``compressed.txt``.

compy2.py.summary: Compress Python sources for an LLM prompt, with a header note.
details: Same pipeline as :doc:`compy` (comments, docstrings, annotations and stdlib imports removed, short names, joined statements) and a ``COMPRESSION_NOTE`` header that explains the transformation to the model, written to ``compressed.txt``.

copilot_noneng.py.summary: Detect the non-English lines of text files.
details: Runs gcld3, pycld2 and langdetect on each line, combines their votes, reports the lines that are not English in a JSON file and parallelises either by file (default) or by line.

cout.py.summary: Comment out (or un-comment) a line range of a file.
details: Applies the comment prefix that matches the file type (``#``, ``//``, ``--``, ``"`` ...), accepts ranges and stdin (``-``), and offers ``-r`` to un-comment, ``--dry-run``, ``--output``, ``--backup``, ``--encoding`` and ``--preserve-shebang``; the work is chunked across a pool.

cout2.py.summary: Comment or un-comment a line range with the right token per language.
details: The ``comment`` subcommand picks the token from the extension (``#``, ``//``, ``--``, ``;`` ...) or ``--token``, can undo with ``--undo`` and offers ``--dry-run``, ``--stdout`` and ``--backup``.

crmc.py.summary: Strip the comments and docstrings of Python files with LibCST.
details: Removes the comments and the docstrings (preserving the shebangs, the encoding declarations and the ``# type:`` comments), validates the result, writes it atomically and supports ``--dry-run``, ``--diff``, ``--backup``, ``--stats`` and every pool dispatch method. Requires Python 3.12+.

ctrans.py.summary: Translate a one-word-per-line file into a JSON map with many backends.
details: Supports deep_translator, DeepL, LibreTranslate, translate, Bing, googletrans, boto3, Baidu, Alibaba, Watson and Azure, keeps the progress across the runs, retries with backoff, throttles the requests per worker and logs the failures to ``failed.txt`` and a rotating log.

dataconv.py.summary: Convert tabular data between CSV, JSON, JSONL, SQLite, SQL, Excel, Parquet and the other supported formats.
details: Detects the source format from the suffix or the SQLite magic bytes, loads the tables (optionally through an mmap for the big files), and writes them out in any registered format, keeping the multi-table structure where the target supports it.

dbconverter.py.summary: Convert data files between JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, pickle, SQLite, Parquet and Excel.
details: Sniffs the input format (with the SQLite header check), reads it into a table list and writes the target format inferred from ``-d`` or ``-o``, defaulting the output name to the input path with the new extension.

Subcommands: ``add-files`` stores every file of the directory (text truncated, binaries 7z-compressed) in a table, ``sqlite-to-json`` dumps a database to one or per-table JSON files, ``md-to-sqlite`` parses a ruff-style rule file, ``search-rule`` looks a rule up, ``mdb-to-json`` converts Access databases through pyodbc and ``sql-to-json`` turns INSERT dumps into NDJSON.

dduper.py.summary: Find the repeated top-level Python objects and optionally move or copy them to ``utils.py``.
details: Hashes every function, class and constant (ast or tree-sitter, archives included), groups the identical ones and, with ``-m``, writes them to ``utils.py``, removes them from the sources and adds the import; ``-c`` copies them without touching the originals.

dedup_func.py.summary: Detect and refactor the duplicate Python functions of a project.
details: Subcommands: ``single`` finds (and with ``-r`` interactively removes) the duplicates of one file, ``scan`` produces exact and fuzzy JSON reports of a tree, ``consolidate`` moves the duplicates into a shared module (``--refactor``, ``--threshold``) and ``prune`` removes the functions matching a reference file.

deduper.py.summary: Move or copy the repeated top-level Python objects into ``utils.py``.
details: Extracts the definitions with ast or tree-sitter (also from the zip, tar, gzip, xz and zstd archives), hashes them, writes the shared ones into ``utils.py`` and, with ``-m``, adds the import to each source after the module docstring; ``-c`` only copies.

dedupfunc.py.summary: Find and optionally remove the duplicate functions of a Python file.
details: Compares the normalized function bodies with ast, prints each duplicate group and with ``-r`` asks which definition to keep before deleting the others (``--backup`` keeps a copy).

deduplicate_python.py.summary: Consolidate the duplicated Python objects of a tree into ``utils.py``.
details: Hashes the top-level definitions (ast or tree-sitter, archives included), writes the repeated ones into ``utils.py`` and rewrites the sources with ``-m`` (import inserted, snippets removed) or only copies them with ``-c``.

delemp.py.summary: Remove the blank lines from text files recursively and in parallel.
details: Deletes the empty lines (``-s`` also the whitespace-only ones) from the given paths, skips the binaries with a short report, prints per-file and summary statistics and supports ``--no-color``.
